dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "My household cats keep knocking my bonsai trees down. They've broken more than a dozen pots already, but I don't want to have to choose between them or my plants. Any suggestions?"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "I have an idea! You can buy your plants at the 'Vesnici Proleca Greenhouse'! Theirs are made with white iron alloys. Your cats could attack them, and they wouldn't even dent!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "It's true they don't break easily. I bought a few pots for my home, but one of my cats pushed a pot down when I was sitting directly under it..."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "So yeah... I can vouch for their very, very sturdy white iron alloy composition..."
